map.约束用具使用时长松解周期 使用指南: Restraint Duration and Release Cycle User Guide
map.约束用具松解提醒器，计时约束使用并每2小时提醒松解与皮肤评估记录，保障患者安全与: A restraint release reminder timer that tracks restraint use and reminds every 2 hours to release and record a skin assessment, protecting patient safety and comfort.
map.身体约束每 2 小时松解一次，活动肢体并评估皮肤与末梢循环 15 分钟。: Release body restraints every 2 hours, move the limbs and assess skin and peripheral circulation for 15 minutes.
map.夜间加强巡视，按躁动程度调整松解频次并记录。: Increase night-time rounds, adjust the release frequency by agitation level and record it.
map.约束指征解除即刻撤除，转适应证评估与家属沟通。: Remove restraints as soon as the indication resolves, moving to assessment against indications and communication with family.

map.胃管深度(鼻尖-耳垂-剑突)测量器: Gastric tube depth (nose tip - earlobe - xiphoid) measurer
map.本工具能替代约束评估记录吗？: Can this tool replace the restraint assessment record?
map.不能，仅作周期提醒，正式记录按约束知情同意与每班评估单。: No — cycle reminders only; formal records follow restraint informed consent and the per-shift assessment form.
map.松解时发现皮肤发红怎么办？: What if the skin turns red during a release?
map.延长松解、局部减压并上报，必要时请压疮小组会诊。: Extend the release, relieve pressure locally and escalate; consult the pressure ulcer team if needed.
map.约束最长能持续多久？: How long can restraints last at most?
map.无绝对上限但须每日医嘱续开并复评指征，尽量缩短。: No absolute upper limit, but the medical order must be renewed daily with indications reassessed, and the duration kept as short as possible.
